thread:
nina: Observed kernel fallback surge in eu-central after runtime:v3.3.0 unpin. p95 for longseq jobs jumped from ~160ms -> ~780ms. Suspect new kernel heuristic.
marco: Which models and fleets? Is this canary-only?

nina: Affects model-group=longseq, both staging and canary fleets in eu-central. Non-eu regions fine. Snippet from traces: fallback_count 0.02 -> 0.45 during the window.

jas: We should avoid global pins. Propose scoped pin of runtime to last known-good v3.2.5 for model-group=longseq in eu-central for 4h while runtime team inspects kernel selector.

ops-bot: Quick checklist: 
- Incident channel notified: #incidents (done)
- Oncall paged? No (pinging now)
- Suggested mitigation: scoped pin or regional routing stall.

marco: Pin sounds reasonable. Will we lose any features by pinning? Runtime v3.2.5 lacks the new prefetch optimization but that's acceptable short-term.

jas: I'll run the pin command. Command: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.2.5 --scope=region:eu-central --filter=model-group:longseq --expires=4h --reason="kernel fallbacks after v3.3.0 unpin"`
deploy-bot: No conflicting pins detected. To apply run the exact command above. Pins are audit-logged.

nina: Adding quick monitoring checkpoints: check p95 at +5m and +20m. If improvement not seen by +20m, escalate to P0 and consider rollback.

jas: Applying now: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.2.5 --scope=region:eu-central --filter=model-group:longseq --expires=4h --reason="kernel fallbacks after v3.3.0 unpin"`
deploy-bot: Pin created ✅
- pin_id: pin-20260321-1103
- target: runtime:v3.2.5
- scope: region=eu-central, filter=model-group=longseq
- expires: 4h
- initiated_by: jas

runtime-bot: Noted. Applying routing table updates and warming instances. Will post p95 snapshot at +5m.

marco: Thanks. Runtime team please post root cause findings in this thread and PRs for kernel-selector tweaks.

nina: Update: +5m p95 dropped to 170ms. Looks like pin helped. We'll keep pin while root cause is investigated.

jas: Leaving pin in place for now. If runtime team needs extension -> start a new thread with justification and metrics.
